name: Svarog
subtitle: Father of Fire
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Blacksmith of the gods, Svarog forged much of Vyraj itself. That creation is imperfect has always eaten at him, and the Shattering has only salted that wound. Furious at Chaos and Destiny both, he is among the most vocal champions of Order, and seeks nothing less than the opportunity to recreate the world in its most perfect potential form.
divinity_generator: Gain [15] Divinity when hit by an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Ignore RES +20%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%, C.DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Anvil Sparks
skills.description: Place [mechanic:res-up-ii] and [mechanic:def-up-ii] on all allies for 3 turns. Then place [mechanic:shield]250% DEF on all allies.
skills.awakening_bonus: When an ally [Shield] is removed or depleted, place [Ward] on them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Seared Strike
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (280%DEF+160%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:blunt-ii] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Forgefire Protection
skills.description: Each time an ally uses an Ultimate, Decreases the damage received by all allies by 3% (up to 10 times).
skills.awakening_bonus: Each Ultimate also increases the strength of [Shield's] placed by this hero by 3% (up to 10 times)

skills.name: Celestial Hammer
skills.description: Attack all enemies (330%DEF+160%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:atk-down-ii] on each target for 2 turns. Also place [mechanic:protect-ii] on all allies for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Each time an ally is attacked under [Protect II] increases the damage of this hero’s next ability by 3%. Resets on next ability.

imprint_passive: Each time an ally uses an Ultimate, Decreases the damage received by this hero by 3% (up to 5 times).
